gate1_structural_improvement.definition: reproducible reduction in persistent syntax defects and incorrect indentation transitions vs the stage-12 champion

gate2_complete_generation.definition: increase in complete, syntactically valid programs under unchanged evaluation conditions

gate3_functional_correctness.definition: at least one generated program compiles, executes and passes independent tests
gate3_functional_correctness.measured: any arm pass@1 > 0 on v1/v3 (execution verified)

gate4_generalization.definition: success on previously unseen tasks and perturbed formulations

gate5_capability_promotion.definition: at least one independently verified pass@1 on an immutable unseen benchmark
gate5_capability_promotion.measured: identical evidence to gate3 by definition

promotion_decision: NOT PROMOTED - pass@1 remains 0.0 (or held-out regression); negative result preserved; stage-12 champion retained

rollback.procedure: restore the stage-12 champion (artifacts are gitignored and additive; stage-13 checkpoints do not overwrite stage-12 files)

experiment.hardware: CPU-only host (5 cores, 5.92 GB RAM, 0 CUDA devices)
experiment.pre_registered_hypothesis: the pre-registered 5-gate hierarchy is applied exactly as registered before any stage-13 execution; pass@1 = 0 implies NOT PROMOTED regardless of loss or syntax improvements
experiment.acceptance_criteria: gates evaluated from measured per-task results; champion selected under the pre-registered rule
